name: Shentong Technology Group Co., Ltd
summary: Shentong Technology Group Co., Ltd engages in research and development, manufacturing, and sales of automotive power system, interior and exterior system, and molds in China and internationally. The company offers oil filters and pans, active oil-gas separators, air ducts, pressure tubes, oil-gas separators, and intake manifolds; and car interior parts, including front B-pillar trim, cabin cover, external columns, and PC glass. It also provides car highlights and new energy parts. Shentong Technology Group Co., Ltd was founded in 2005 and is based in Yuyao, China.
